authorities_frozen.commands_events: Presentation requests actions, simulation resolves and emits results (docs/product/VERDIGRIS_CONSTITUTION.md 'Native architecture invariant'); presentation events carry no gameplay authority (native/client/presentation_events.hpp:3-6).

authorities_frozen.d115_play_verdicts: Feel-affecting work is not ACCEPTED until the architect drives a full session of the actual build (orchestration/DECISIONS.md D-115).
authorities_frozen.art_direction: D-113: procedural/vector-first, documented relative scale; owner supplies/approves new image assets (orchestration/DECISIONS.md D-113).

classification_legend.COMPLETE: Simulation contract plus presentation handling plus at least one locking test or deterministic capture all exist for the audited aspect.
classification_legend.PARTIAL: Some layers exist with evidence, but at least one named gap is documented below.
classification_legend.MISSING: The aspect has no proved implementation or no proved visual timing/capture.
classification_legend.OWNER-ASSET: Blocked on owner art-direction decisions per D-113; contract/test decomposition continues without generating art.

matrix.aspect: presentation movement animation (walk cycle, position smoothing, motion of the billboard itself)
simulation_authority: Sim owns positions/timing only; it emits no animation-phase data (no gait phase, no speed fraction beyond position deltas).
presentation_only: Actor world positions snap per tick with no interpolation between samples: native/client/presentation_state.cpp:90-91 (protocol_to_world scale only).
Billboards are static sprites mirrored horizontally; there is no walk cycle, bob, lean, or lunge anywhere in draw code: native/client/main.cpp:1120-1183.

gaps: No walk/run cycle, no attack lunge, no spawn/death body animation; movement reads as teleport-per-tick at 20 Hz.
